title: Evidence-Gated Real-Corpus Research Workflow Evaluation
non_scope: forcing artificial workload to manipulate observatory readiness
acceptance_criteria: Preflight forensic checks verify observed_at determinism (Check A) and operational threshold semantics (Check B).
Wayfinder decision establishes smallest real-corpus research evaluation without premature platform expansion.
Narrow KAD-PI research question formulated in deterministic vs probabilistic agent control / evidence-grounded execution.
Bounded real corpus assembled with complete provenance metadata and verified epistemic classes (no synthetic papers or fabricated citations).

Existing research pipeline exercised end-to-end: import, canonical normalization, provenance retention, deduplication, retrieval, evidence extraction, citation linkage, synthesis, context handoff, and graceful fallback.
Free-first/TOKENMAXXING policy preserved without unnecessary premium token expenditure.
Observatory records natural operational metrics passively without synthetic workload or routing overrides.
All 510+ regression tests remain green and doctor diagnostics report PASS.
description: Evidence-gated real-corpus research workflow evaluation testing existing KAD research stack on a bounded set of real papers with full provenance, retrieval, extraction, and fallback verification.
